title: Divine Farmer Agricultural AI Model
summary: China Telecom reports agricultural Q&A accuracy above 90% and pest/disease recognition above 85%. These technical capabilities do not establish yield or income gains.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: China Telecom reports agricultural Q&A accuracy above 90% and pest/disease recognition above 85%. Changes in crop yield, farmer income, pesticide use, and environmental conditions are unmeasured.
purpose: Provide farming advice, pest identification, and agricultural market forecasts.
developer: China Telecom Wanwei Information Technology Co., Ltd.

ratings.reason: China Telecom reports agricultural guidance and image diagnosis, with Q&A accuracy above 90% and pest/disease recognition above 85%. Crop and income gains are unmeasured.
Food security, lower chemical use, and emissions reductions are intended, with no measured field effects.

ai_role.statement: The project account does not separately evaluate AI’s contribution to the benefit.

evidence.citation: Project account in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. Outcomes are reported by the project team. The account provides no independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: Use Case 4: Divine Farmer Agricultural AI Model

produced_by: Conditions that could produce the benefit are unspecified.
must_hold: Agricultural question, image, and market datasets

headline: Divine Farmer provides agricultural guidance
claim_basis: Sources: the makers' report. The cited evidence includes no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
